CREATE TABLE employees (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    role TEXT NOT NULL,
    department TEXT NOT NULL,
    salary INTEGER NOT NULL
)

args: {"table_name": "projects"}
result:
CREATE TABLE projects (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    pi_employee_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES employees(id),
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL
)

args: {"table_name": "datasets"}
result:
CREATE TABLE datasets (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    classification TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (classification IN ('public', 'internal', 'restricted')),
    size_gb REAL NOT NULL,
    owner_email TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

args: {"table_name": "experiments"}
result:
CREATE TABLE experiments (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
    dataset_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES datasets(id),
    run_label TEXT NOT NULL,
    started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes TEXT
)

args: {"table_name": "publications"}
result:
CREATE TABLE publications (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    venue TEXT,
    year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    doi TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    project_id INTEGER REFERENCES projects(id)
)

    pi_employee_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES employees(id),
    amount_usd REAL NOT NULL,
    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL
)
